cards.name: Airbrush 1
cards.path: Window/Graphic Style Libraries/Additive for Blob Brush
cards.summary: Additive Gaussian Blur: keeps the object's hue but comes out paler than the original colour, with every edge softened into an airbrushed haze about as soft as Blur-6 px; the star and letters stay readable but fuzzy. depth-of-field layer in a flat illustration
avoid: full-strength colour: the object comes out lighter; use Blur-6 px for the same softness at full colour
small body text: the blur makes it hard to read
final print output at the default raster resolution: the effect is rasterized at Effect > Document Raster Effects Settings, so set 300 ppi before export
